messages:
maria.g: Heads-up — BrightBank reporting repeated 503s and request timeouts from Dedicated pool A (customer P1). SLA at risk if we don't stabilize in the next 2 hours. Who can own incident/patch + short-term routing fallback?
andre.r: I'm on the pool side. seeing increased tail latencies on GPU nodes 4/5. Might be KV cache pressure + a bad quantized model variant.
sam.t: I'll pick up hotpatch for inference routing. prepping a branch now, will open PR in ~15m. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/route-fallback/pulls/42
lina.k: If we redirect to the cheaper model variant we need a small output schema shim — a quick transform in the proxy should work, ETA 30m.
maria.g: Plan: (1) immediate routing policy to exclude node 4/5 (andre) (2) enable fallback to variant-B with proxy shim (sam + lina) (3) monitor p99 and error rate and update CS. Agree? :point_up:
andre.r: I'll cordon nodes and force drain. Doing check now: `kubectl get pods -l pool=dedicated-A -o wide`
andre.r: Logs show repeated OOM-ish traces for llama-q8 on node-5: `oom: evicting kv cache` — raising memory cap might help short term.
sam.t: PR opened: #42. Hotpatch script (one-liner) below:
```bash
# temporarily route new requests to variant-B
redis-cli HSET routing:dedicated-A fallback_variant "variant-B"
```
lina.k: Proxy shim diff pushed to branch shim/variant-b: small mapping for missing field `score_details` -> `null` so client doesn't break. Will add tests.
maria.g: ETA checkpoints? we need live fallback + verification in 45m, otherwise escalate to postmortem and paging list.
andre.r: Nodes cordoned, draining. I bumped mem limit on node-5 container from 6g -> 8g (short term). Observing.
sam.t: Deployed routing change to canary (10% traffic) at 3770012440. No spike in errors yet.
lina.k: Shim deployed to proxy canary, tests green. Added quick e2e assert to ensure client receives `score_details: null` if absent.
maria.g: Good. monitoring p99 and error rate. @deploy-bot can you post the deploy status?
deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline triggered for route-fallback PR #42 -> canary. Status: SUCCESS (canary: 10%), started at 3770012439.
maria.g: Current status at 20m: errors down 80%, p99 improved but still 1.6x baseline. Next actions: sam to promote to 50% after 15m if stable, andre to keep draining/problem node isolation, lina to merge shim to main when green.
sam.t: Will promote to 50% at ~3770012500 unless regressions.
andre.r: Continuing node eviction; collecting heap dumps to send to infra-research.
lina.k: Merging shim in 10m. will notify once main is green.
maria.g: Thanks all — owners recorded: incident owner: maria.g, pool owner: andre.r, routing/patch: sam.t, proxy shim: lina.k. CS updated and customer notified of temporary fallback. Will close thread when 50% -> 100% promote done and p99 stable for 15m. :white_check_mark:
